en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two main images. The left side shows a panoramic view of a mountain valley town with clustered buildings, church towers, and surrounding terraced fields. The right side shows a street scene in front of a hotel with a carriage and people standing by the facade. Italian captions identify the town and the hotel. A large amount of handwritten text in blue ink covers the lower and right margins.
